documents.title: Tablebook (an invented example of a project brief)
documents.description: INVENTED EXAMPLE. Restaurant booking web app, Next.js and Postgres, live with paying customers. Full CI is npm run ci. Deep docs are in the repo's CLAUDE.md and docs/FOUNDATION.md.
documents.source: invented for this repository, to show the shape of a brief

documents.title: Two-tier knowledge pattern (index cheap, content lazy)
documents.description: How to give agents a large knowledge store without filling their context. An always-available one-line index, and documents opened only on demand.
documents.source: the design session for this library

documents.title: CRLF and encoding mismatches fake corruption and drift
documents.description: A hash mismatch across Windows/Linux is not proof a file drifted (CRLF). Normalize line endings before comparing. Garbled log text is often UTF-8 read as CP1252, not corruption.
documents.source: a deploy check on a PHP web app, and a log-health check on a worker

documents.title: A bracket in a git pathspec is a glob, and returns zero silently
documents.description: git reads [name] in a pathspec as a character class, so grep/log against a bracket-named folder silently matches nothing, which looks the same as "the code is gone". Use :(literal).
documents.source: a repository whose folders are bracket-named

documents.title: Mass uniform test failures usually mean one missing prerequisite
documents.description: When a huge block of tests fails uniformly with empty or identical details, suspect one missing prerequisite (interpreter path, env var, credential) near the top of the log, not a regression.
documents.source: a PHP web app's HTTP test suite

documents.title: Backgrounded processes on Windows drop your env vars
documents.description: Prefixing env vars on a backgrounded command from Git Bash silently fails to pass them on. Set them inside the process's own shell with a wrapper script.
documents.source: a PHP web app's test setup, where it happened more than once
